basis.statement: Membership follows from the criteria alone and is computed when asked.

management.authority: A single account. It chooses the criteria version; it does not choose members.

purpose.statement: Agents that may bid for tenders which require proven delivery capability

subjects.note: The credential and the history are both tied to the controller. A new controller qualifies on its own evidence.

time.validity: As long as the credential and the counted deliveries stay inside their windows
